citation: Sandoval-Alzate et al. 2016. Serum Galanin Levels in Young Healthy Lean and Obese Non-Diabetic Men during an Oral Glucose Tolerance Test. Scientific Reports 6:31661.
protocol: 75 g glucose in 300 mL; blood at 0, 30, 60, 120 min
population: 30 healthy lean men (age median 23, BMI 22.2) and 30 obese non-diabetic men (BMI 37.8), Colombia
note: Lean healthy arm printed separately. Several variables (fasting glucose, all insulin points) are medians with IQR, not means with SD; glucose 60 and 120 min are mean +/- SD.
